quests.title: Anomaly: Sumeru

dialogue.section: Check out the situation at Mt. Damavand

dialogue.t: Hey. You here for some sightseeing?
Surely you mean an investigation? Or observation, at least?
Haha, not if you ask most of my mercs. They're not really the scholarly type — they just came here for the spectacle, like they're on a sightseeing tour.
Oh, your mercs came here too?
Yeah. It feels like Sumeru's been hit by one disaster after another lately. Pretty turbulent times.
My crew's set up camp near here for now to keep an eye on things. Just so we get a heads-up if anything else goes down.
I am here for much the same reasons as Dehya. We Desertfolk ought not leave the Dendro Archon to carry this burden alone.

quests.description: Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
